significant events that occur in clinical practice can influence learning.
significant events are a key source of learning for trainees.
In summary, our research is concerned with
understanding the nature and role of significant clinical events in the learning of doctors in training, and how these events influence their practice.
understanding how trainees learn and develop as practitioners.
the role of clinical practice and its relationship with learning in clinical settings.

the most effective way of changing clinical behaviour is to provide the trainee with a structured learning environment in which they are able to reflect on and learn from their experiences.
a good learning environment is essential for a good learning experience, and that a positive learning environment is a prerequisite for effective learning.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the significant events that influence learning are those events that have the most impact on the trainee’s practice.
it is not possible to have a one-size-fits-all approach to learning.
the trainees were able to identify significant events that influenced their clinical learning, and that they were able to identify how these events influenced their learning.

trainees are learning from a variety of sources, including clinical experiences.
trainees’ learning and clinical practice are influenced by significant events that can have a lasting effect.
